content.text: Meaning of champion in English championnoun [ C ] us Your browser doesn't support HTML5 audio /ˈtʃæm.pi.ən/ uk Your browser doesn't support HTML5 audio /ˈtʃæm.pi.ən/ champion noun [C] (WINNER) Add to word list Add to word list B1 (informal champ) someone or something, especially a person or animal, that has beaten all other competitors in a competition: an Olympic champion She is the world champion for the third year in succession. The defending champion will play his first match of the tournament tomorrow. Who are the reigning European soccer champions? She's the women's 1500 m champion .He looks set to become world champion again this year.The defending champion will play her first match of the tournament tomorrow.Who are the reigning NFL champions?And our quiz champion tonight, with 46 points, is Jackie. (Definition of champion from the Cambridge Academic Content Dictionary © Cambridge University Press) Examples of champion champion My mother taught me that everybody needs a chance and a champion. From International Business Times Also, for a show that was supposed to be about champions, there was only one championship match on the entire show. From Philly.com The world of social media gives consumers the ability to find each other and to really champion these causes. From Reuters Many of the shows we look forward to might not be on the air if some influential and smart men hadn't championed them. From Slate Magazine A two-time scoring champion by the age of 23, looked up to by youngsters, respected by the old heads. From ESPN We all now have our favorite pieces we'd like him to champion. From Los Angeles Times Salt and pepper are the undisputed champions of condiments -- but how did they get so popular? From Gizmodo It is a rare occurrence, and it still doesn't mean you'll be crowned overall champion. From CNN Not everyone can be champions; not everyone should be champions. From New York Post We can not help but expect someone with the grand-sounding title of chancellor to be more of our champion. From New York Daily News There were always people who loved and championed it. From CNN Thank you for showing me that a true champion never doubts himself and never allows anyone to bring him down. From The Seattle Times He was a true champion and never backed down. From cleveland.com And then let's take the last one, championing small business.
